full_page.content:
Page 19 Feb. 27 Jackie Norton - 6 - strep infection and abcessed ear.
7 Duane Smith of Lansing - 21 - Rhumatic fever and Sinus
1942, March
March Mrs. Laethem - 26 - in threaten condition - asks for prayers that baby
Olivia Ann Sam
Fr. Path Redemptorist - Sick
Mar. 2 Geo Langhurst - 39 - drinking ... has not been to church in ten months .... bad company
Hattie Jacobs - Jewess - about 40
4 Layton Stanley Brayman - 33 - in bad company - neglecting-wife and family, Even has started divorce ... wife baptized Catholic but left orphan and raised without religion.
Edna Ward - 40 - dizzy spells - falls as though intoxicated.
Henry Hoffman - 26 - in Monroe, Mich. Apendicitis, pneumonia, blood clot and negligent in religion.
Page 20
March 5 Floyd Heideman - 30 - Evangelist - not well - family trouble - Parents ask prayers.
6 John Claus - 64 - a morman - a coffin maker - inward hemorages. Asks for prayers. His Doctor ( Robb) a practical Catholic brought him to the Monastery To-day.
Barbara Ann Coyne - 5 - in Harper - Mastoid operation To-day - now in "Oxigan tank" 12th coming along fine.
8 Peter O'Doherty - 42 - Infantile paralysis since a year old - one leg and side quite weak. Enrolled To-day.
8 Allen Schneller - 51 - Luthern, wife Catholic - Comparatively in good health but ... ! is frequently thrown out of bed and chucked a- gainst the wall by an invisible power. Now and a fearful looking demon appears to him ... two pairs of glasses have been smashed in this.
